title: convolith artifact record v1
description: One immutable stored artifact, content-addressed by SHA-256. Mirrors src/model.rs::ArtifactRecord and the ledger `artifact_ref` table (src/ledger.rs).

artifact_id.description: Deterministic id over the SHA-256 digest: `art_` + first 24 hex chars of BLAKE3("sha256", <digest>).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the stored bytes. Identical bytes are stored once.

mime.description: Optional; guessed from the filename when the caller passes none.

source_path.description: Where the bytes were seen, as discovered.

copied.description: Absent means true. False when the payload exceeded the artifact limit: hash and size are recorded, the bytes are not in the store.

stored_path.description: Relative path inside the dataset: artifacts/<stored_path>. A payload larger than the artifact limit is hashed and reported but not copied, so the file may legitimately be absent.
